Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>

    Bug 2018952 - Part3:  Make UPX a bootstrapped toolchain. rs=bustage-fix
    
    Port https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/87191d0ecb4e

diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win32/common-win32 b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win32/common-win32
index 17f9ea34fa1..2802da2eb01 100644
--- a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win32/common-win32
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win32/common-win32
@@ -3,17 +3,3 @@
 ac_add_options --target=i686-pc-windows-msvc
 
 . $topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.clang-cl
-
-if test `uname -s` = Linux; then
-
-# Configure expects executables for check_prog, so set the relevant files
-# as executable on the first evaluation of the mozconfig where they exist.
-export UPX="${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR}/upx/bin/upx.exe"
-if [ -f "${UPX}" ]; then
-    chmod +x "${UPX}"
-fi
-mk_add_options "export PATH=${VC_PATH}/bin/hostx64/x86:${PATH}"
-
-unset VC_PATH
-
-fi
diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64 b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64

+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64-aarch64/common-win64

 . $topsrcdir/build/mozconfig.clang-cl
 
-if test `uname -s` = Linux; then
-
-# Configure expects executables for check_prog, so set the relevant files
-# as executable on the first evaluation of the mozconfig where they exist.
-export UPX="${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR}/upx/bin/upx.exe"
-if [ -f "${UPX}" ]; then
-    chmod +x "${UPX}"
-fi
-
-fi
-
 if test -n "$USE_ARTIFACT"; then
 ac_add_options --disable-mapi
 fi

+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/win64/common-win64
